altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sharing a side hug and reaching toward each other on staggered seats on a wooden terrace. A misty green valley and distant volcanic cone fill the background. They wear two blue-white-red flag-pattern mini outfits, a coral cropped top with a black stitched mini skirt, and a green leaf-embroidered mini dress. Rainbow legwear is paired with ivory pumps, coral knee-high boots, green ankle boots and rainbow platforms. Small RAZE marks and star-themed details decorate some pieces.
